purpose: Per-CpG cross-disease firing-pattern residual map for Stage 8 Route A residual-map-overlap channel in the immune-atlas universal baseline card. Captures CpGs that fire across multiple diseases, with the four firing-pattern classifications operationalizing the VAL-016 cross-disease universal alarm doctrine at per-CpG resolution.
method: Inner-join of breast-EPIC pre-dx and AD-immune residual maps on cpg_id, with per-disease mean Cohen's d, sign, and disease-internal concordance preserved. Cross-disease firing pattern classified into four mutually exclusive buckets using the source files' concordant_strong flags as the disease-internal concordance criterion.

source_artifacts.name: breast_epic_residual_map_chr_annotated.csv
source_artifacts.validation_anchor: CPG-VAL-003 cross-cohort residual concordance (GSE51057 + GSE51032 long_pre_dx >10y breast)

source_artifacts.name: ad_immune_residual_map_chr_annotated.csv
source_artifacts.validation_anchor: CPG-VAL-013 cross-cohort AD residual map (AIBL + AddNeuroMed)

schema.breast_d_GSE51057: Cohen's d in breast pre-dx >10y EPIC-Italy GSE51057
schema.breast_d_GSE51032: Cohen's d in breast pre-dx >10y EPIC-Italy GSE51032
schema.breast_d_mean: Mean Cohen's d across breast cohorts (signed)
schema.breast_concordant_strong: Source flag from breast residual map — both breast cohorts strong AND same direction
schema.ad_d_AIBL: Cohen's d in AD AIBL cohort
schema.ad_d_AddNeuroMed: Cohen's d in AD AddNeuroMed cohort
schema.ad_d_mean: Mean Cohen's d across AD cohorts (signed)
schema.ad_concordant_strong: Source flag from AD residual map — both AD cohorts strong AND same direction
schema.cross_disease_firing_pattern: One of 5 mutually exclusive buckets (see firing_pattern_definitions below)
schema.cross_disease_mean_abs_d: Mean of breast_mean_abs_d and ad_mean_abs_d (cross-disease magnitude)

firing_pattern_definitions.fires_in_both_diseases_same_direction: CpG fires concordantly in BOTH breast cohorts AND BOTH AD cohorts, with the same overall sign across diseases — cross-disease concordance pattern (shared inflammation/aging drift candidates)
firing_pattern_definitions.fires_in_both_diseases_opposing_directio: CpG fires concordantly in BOTH breast cohorts AND BOTH AD cohorts, with OPPOSING signs across diseases — THE VAL-016 BIDIRECTIONAL UNIVERSAL ALARM SIGNATURE. Pooled (sign-aligned) tests cancel; directional decomposition recovers signal.
firing_pattern_definitions.fires_in_both_diseases_ambiguous_sign: CpG fires concordantly in both diseases but at least one disease has zero mean d (degenerate case, rare)
firing_pattern_definitions.fires_breast_only: CpG fires concordantly in BOTH breast cohorts but NOT concordantly in AD
firing_pattern_definitions.fires_AD_only: CpG fires concordantly in BOTH AD cohorts but NOT concordantly in breast
firing_pattern_definitions.fires_neither_background: CpG does NOT meet concordant_strong threshold in EITHER disease — background reservoir, not part of operational alarm signature

validation_anchors_inherited: CPG-VAL-016 (cross-disease universal alarm directional — pooled NULL informative, directional recovery)

operational_use.consumed_by: immune-atlas card v2.1 Stage 8 Route A — residual-map-overlap channel parallel to breast and AD-immune disease cards
operational_use.stage_8_overlap_method: Pearson correlation of patient per-CpG departure (post-Stage 3) with cross-disease firing-pattern map signed Cohen's d, computed separately for fires_in_both_diseases_same_direction subset (cross-disease concordance channel) and fires_in_both_diseases_opposing_direction subset (bidirectional universal alarm channel). Fisher z-transform CI for confidence bounds.
operational_use.stage_4_5_relationship: The fires_in_both_diseases_opposing_direction subset is the per-CpG operationalization of the VAL-051 7-CpG directional panel. The 7-CpG panel is a small high-precision instrument inside Stage 4.5; this residual map is the broader per-CpG signature for Stage 8 Route A overlap matching.
operational_use.relationship_to_val_051_directional_pane: The VAL-051 7-CpG directional panel and this cross-disease residual map are DISJOINT instruments by design, not overlapping. VAL-051 7-CpG panel CpGs (cg16867657, cg25809905, cg22454769, cg09809672, cg26614073, cg00431549, cg02228185) were selected via Rule A criterion (|Δβ|>0.015 AND q_FDR<0.10) on AIBL training split alone using pre-build methodology, and are NOT in the post-build VAL-003 breast or VAL-013 AD residual map CpG universes. The cross-disease residual map's 12 opposing-direction CpGs (cg00932141, cg01006587, cg05257202, cg08200043, cg08886001, cg09622285, cg12565635, cg15459165, cg18332838, cg18418928, cg20700762, cg26131879) come from the intersection of the post-build breast + AD residual maps with the opposing-direction criterion. The two instruments operate complementarily: VAL-051 is the high-precision Stage 4.5 within-AD directional discriminator (AUC=0.84 AIBL holdout); this map is the broader Stage 8 Route A cross-disease overlap channel.

honest_caveats: The 12-CpG opposing-direction subset and the VAL-051 7-CpG panel are DISJOINT — they share zero CpGs. This is expected because VAL-051 was selected from AIBL-only using pre-build methodology, while this map intersects post-build VAL-003 (breast) + VAL-013 (AD) residual maps. The two instruments are complementary, not redundant. A future v0.2 could merge both candidate universes — pending Heath direction.

v0.1 derives entirely from existing sealed VAL artifacts (CPG-VAL-003 breast + CPG-VAL-013 AD). Does NOT independently re-validate the cross-disease firing patterns — inherits the validation status of its source artifacts.
Two-disease intersection only (breast pre-dx + AD). Future v0.2 may add CRC, lung, or autoimmune cohorts as sealed residual maps become available.
The fires_neither_background bucket is the dominant pattern by count — most CpGs in either source map do NOT fire concordantly in both diseases. The cross-disease alarm subset is a small fraction.
Not a sealed VAL — derived vault artifact (parallels IAMAtlas_age_layer.csv and directional_panels_v1_0.json which are also derived artifacts without their own VAL seals).
Stage 8 Route A overlap thresholds for the new channel not yet calibrated — pending first patient cohort runs through immune-atlas v2.1 chain.

Bidirectional pattern interpretation depends on disease-direction priors: breast pre-dx hypermethylates while AD hypomethylates — this is the canonical opposing-direction example. Other disease pairs may have different direction conventions.
